glyph.isekai_mahou.beam.desc: Fires an instant ray of light up to 24 blocks long. Pierce passes through targets, Split fans out several beams and Ricochet bounces off walls. In a program, it starts from the point that was hit; On End fires at the tip of the ray if it hits nothing.
glyph.isekai_mahou.cone.desc: Releases a 60° fan in front of you that hits everything inside it (6 blocks; Expand reaches farther and wider). In a program, it opens from the point that was hit; with Leap, it rushes to the next enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.slash.desc: A 120° blade arc 3.5 blocks long that hits everyone in the arc. Split chains extra X-shaped strikes. In a program, the blade appears at the point that was hit; with Leap, it flies to the next enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.nova.desc: Explodes around you, hitting everything within 4 blocks with a shockwave. In a program (after On Hit, On End...), it explodes at the point that was hit; with Leap, it lands on the next enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.wave.desc: A wave that rushes along the ground where you look, climbs steps and hits each creature in its path once. Expand makes it wider. In a program, it starts at the point that was hit and keeps the same direction.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fall.desc: Makes the spell fall from the sky like a meteor where you aim (up to 48 blocks), exploding in a 3-block area. In a program, it falls on the point that was hit; On End fires when the meteor hits the ground.
glyph.isekai_mahou.rain.desc: Forms a magic cloud over the aimed spot: for 3 seconds, many small impacts fall at random within 5 blocks. In a program, the cloud forms over the point that was hit; On Hit fires when a drop strikes a creature.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mark.desc: Marks the creature in your sights (up to 32 blocks), making it glow; 2 seconds later the spell falls on it, wherever it is. In a program, it marks the creature at the point that was hit (or the next one in the same direction); with Leap, the mark jumps from enemy to enemy.
message.isekai_mahou.forms_a.mark_no_tar: Nothing in your sights to mark.
command.isekai_mahou.fx.stats: Batched effects: %s items in %s packets (used to be %s packets — %sx fewer). Dropped: %s.
command.isekai_mahou.fx.stress: Load test: %s effects every 2 ticks for %s s. The result shows up at the end.
command.isekai_mahou.fx.reactions: %s reactions in the same tick: %s full, %s light, %s mechanics only.
